title: Shem Creek Marina
specs: Located in the heart of Shem Creek neighborhood known for shrimp boats, dolphin sightings, and waterfront restaurants
No boating license required for rentals
includes: Unlimited free wash-downs and engine flushing included with every launch and return
gap: Prices for boat rentals not stated
blurb: Shem Creek Marina offers dry stack boat storage for boats up to 30 feet with valet launch service. They provide premium boat rentals including pontoons, center consoles, and deck boats available by the half day or full day. The marina features clean facilities, on-site fueling, and an outdoor deck with waterfront views.
extraNote: Online reservations available to schedule launch time in advance · 526 Mill Street, Mount Pleasant, SC 29464

quotes.author: Matthew Jennings
quotes.text: Matthew Jennings3 months agoShem Creek’s Marina is upheld by some of the best people in the marine industry. Michael Onorato is someone who leads this marina followed by Jack. They will make sure you are always taken care of. Kurt who works alongside them but works for Motorboat Mechanics is also a person I could only recommend. I hope this helps any client looking for gas, boat storage, or just a place to be around.
